q.t: Pressure = ?
q.e: Force spread over an area.

q.t: The SI unit of pressure is the…
q.e: 1 Pa = 1 N/m².

q.t: Air moves from…
q.e: It stops when pressures equal.

q.t: During the day the breeze blows from…
q.e: Land heats faster, air rises over land.

q.t: The calm centre of a cyclone is the…
q.e: Lowest pressure, calm wind.

q.t: Cyclones form over…
q.e: Warm water fuels them.

q.t: Thunder is caused by…
o: Lightning rapidly heating and expanding air
q.e: The air expands violently.

q.t: Air is normally an electrical…
q.e: Until charge builds up enough to break down.

q.t: 1 hectopascal (hPa) equals how many Pa?
q.e: Same as 1 millibar.

q.t: Which agency gives cyclone warnings in India?
q.e: The India Meteorological Department.

q.t: Why do broad bag straps hurt less?
o: Same weight over a larger area means less pressure
q.e: Pressure = force ÷ area.

q.t: Why does a nail's pointed end go in easily?
q.e: Concentrating force increases pressure.

q.t: Liquid pressure depends on…
q.e: Equal heights in wide and narrow pipes give equal bulges.

q.t: Why are overhead water tanks placed high?
o: Taller column → greater pressure at taps
q.e: More height above the tap, stronger flow.

q.t: Water spurts from holes in all sides of a bottle. This shows liquids exert pressure…
q.e: That's why leaky pipe joints fountain.

q.t: Why is a dam's base broader than its top?
o: Water pressure is greatest at the bottom
q.e: Pressure increases with depth.

q.t: Why aren't we crushed by atmospheric pressure?
o: Pressure inside our bodies balances it
q.e: Internal pressure equals atmospheric pressure.

q.t: A rubber sucker sticks because…
o: Outside air pressure is higher than inside
q.e: Pressing pushes air out from underneath.

q.t: Blowing between two hanging balloons makes them…
q.e: Fast air lowers pressure between them.

q.t: During a high-wind storm you should…
q.e: Reduces the pressure difference across the roof.

q.t: A force of 100 N acts on 2 m². Pressure (Pa)?
A force of 600 N acts on 3 m². Pressure (Pa)?
Same force, area halved. Pressure becomes…
q.e: Pressure = force ÷ area.

q.t: Why does a tap on the first floor run harder than one on the second floor (roof tank)?
q.e: Pressure depends on height of the column.

q.t: Why do roofs blow off in storms?
o: Fast wind lowers pressure above; normal pressure below pushes up
q.e: A large pressure difference lifts a weak roof.

q.t: What is the engine of a cyclone?
q.e: That's why they weaken over land.

q.t: What makes a cyclone spin?
q.e: Without rotation, air would just rise.

q.t: A storm surge is…
o: A wall of seawater 3–12 m pushed ashore
q.e: It floods coastal areas.

q.t: During lightning, you should…
o: Crouch low in an open area
q.e: Minimise ground contact; avoid tall objects.

q.t: A lightning conductor works by…
o: Giving charge an easy path into the ground
q.e: Pointed top above the building; bottom buried deep.

q.t: Air over 15 cm × 15 cm pushes with about 2250 N. What is this pressure in Pa? (area = 0.0225 m²)
q.e: 2250 ÷ 0.0225 = 100,000 Pa — about atmospheric pressure.

q.t: Two pipes of different widths filled to the same height. Their balloons bulge…
q.e: Pressure depends on height, not quantity.

q.t: Why is an unfolded sheet on the paper plate harder to lift?
o: Air pushes on a larger area — more force
q.e: Same pressure × more area = more force.

q.t: Why does a land breeze blow at night?
o: Land cools faster, so warmer air rises over the sea
q.e: Low pressure forms over the sea.

q.t: Why do cyclones weaken over land?
o: No warm ocean water to supply heat
q.e: Their engine is condensation heat from evaporated seawater.

q.t: Why does seawater rushing inland harm farms for years?
q.e: Saltwater damages farmland.

q.t: Kalboishakhi is a thunderstorm in…
q.e: Bordoisila is in Assam.

q.t: Cyclone Amphan (2020) had peak winds of about…
q.e: Extremely destructive winds.

q.t: Why is it safer inside a bus or car during lightning?
q.e: Stay inside a vehicle rather than in the open.

q.t: The bigger the pressure difference, the…
q.e: That's why winds vary day to day.
